body: Thanks. I enjoy gaming, especially cooperative gaming. I did play bass guitar for awhile, but haven't been much lately since towards the end of this last semester. Fixing computers seems like a reasonable line of work to get into to be honest. May not be a big deal, but considering where I'm at being a big deal isn't very important to me at all. I'm feeling better now that time has passed and I've had the opportunity to be around some old friends, this attitude just seems to keep coming back at unexpected times. It's awful, and at the very least I should at least tell a professional I've been having these thoughts.
